items.title: Reconcile your books faster — Trial Balance by any period
items.summary: The Trial Balance moves from daily-only Excel/PDF exports into a live, interactive report inside Mews Operations. Finance teams can select any date range, view summarized ledger data directly in Mews, and export to Excel, CSV, or PDF via the Export queue.
items.segmentation: Segmented release to US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico

items.title: Manage languages and services on Central products (Mews Multi-Property)
items.summary: Central products can now support multiple languages, which automatically propagate to local-level products. Central and local-level products can also now be connected via a Central service instead of a service key.
items.pitch: Central products just got more flexible — multiple languages roll down to every local property automatically, and linking products no longer means juggling service keys.

items.title: Automate financial reporting — scheduled exports for deposit & guest ledgers
items.summary: Properties can now set up recurring, scheduled exports for the deposit and guest ledgers, with custom frequency and automatic delivery — instead of running these exports manually every time.
items.pitch: No more remembering to pull deposit and guest ledger exports by hand — set the schedule once and the data lands automatically, right when finance needs it for reconciliation.
items.segmentation: Available to all Mews Operations users

items.title: Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS
items.summary: Properties can now configure Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS, recording how much guests typically spend on services beyond their room (dining, spa). RMS adds that expected spend to the room rate when working out what a booking is worth.
items.pitch: Properties already earn real money from dining, spa, and other on-property spend — this lets that spend inform the room rate itself. Position it as sharper pricing intelligence, not a new upsell feature.

items.title: Ledger Activity Report focused on meaningful movements
items.summary: The Ledger Activity Report now hides self-balancing postings that net to zero within the selected date range, groups remaining entries by source item, and gives every 0% VAT posting its own zero-value entry in the tax ledger.
items.pitch: Frame it as a clarity upgrade to the Ledger Activity Report — meaningful movements are easier to find (grouped by item, noise removed), and the tax audit trail is now fully complete for 0% VAT postings.

items.title: Uber x Mews beta — in-app guest ride booking
items.summary: Beta properties can now book Uber rides for guests directly inside Mews. 14+ hotels are active across Germany, Austria, UK, US, Netherlands, and Belgium; the team hit its contractual beta deadline (Aug 31) with the first hotel live Aug 17. Building toward GA with guest-facing booking flows and scheduled rides next.
items.segmentation: Beta only (14+ hotels across DE, AT, UK, US, NL, BE) — not yet GA, targeting through end of October

items.title: Duna reaches General Availability
items.summary: Duna was announced as GA in #rnd with only a brief cross-post and no further detail shared in the monitored channels — worth confirming scope/specifics before communicating to customers.

items.title: Competitor pricing teaser for non-RMS properties (Revenue > Overview)
items.summary: Non-RMS properties viewing Revenue > Overview now see a competitor pricing teaser sitting exactly where the real RMS widget lives for RMS customers — demonstrating RMS value in-product rather than via banner or email. Roughly 1.5k weekly active enterprises hit that page; click-through and rejection rates are being measured to see if the pattern works.

items.title: Flexkeeping now preferred housekeeping solution for all of Accor
items.summary: Flexkeeping (Mews housekeeping solution) has become the preferred housekeeping solution across all of Accor. Shared internally in #rnd as a milestone win — no formal release note yet.
